cases.name: cash_per_order_slippage_round_trip
cases.source: Pyne-defined commission/slippage strategy fixture with a Pine-equivalent scaffold for external TradingView export comparison.
cases.script:
strategy("Pine Equivalent Costs", overlay=True, initial_capital=1000, pyramiding=0, mintick=0.1, slippage=2, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_order, commission_value=0.5, process_orders_on_close=True)
strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=1, when=bar_index == 0, price=close)
strategy.close("Long", when=bar_index == 1, price=close)
plot(strategy.position_size, "Position")
plot(strategy.equity, "Equity")
plot(strategy.netprofit, "Net Profit")
plot(strategy.openprofit, "Open Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades, "Closed Trades")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(0), "Closed Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.commission(0), "Closed Commission")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.net_profit(0), "Closed Net Profit")
cases.pine_equivalent:
//@version=5
strategy("Pine Equivalent Costs", overlay=true, initial_capital=1000, pyramiding=0, slippage=2, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_order, commission_value=0.5, process_orders_on_close=true)
if bar_index == 0
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=1)
if bar_index == 1
    strategy.close("Long")
plot(strategy.position_size, "Position")
plot(strategy.equity, "Equity")
plot(strategy.netprofit, "Net Profit")
plot(strategy.openprofit, "Open Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades, "Closed Trades")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(0), "Closed Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.commission(0), "Closed Commission")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(0) - strategy.closedtrades.commission(0), "Closed Net Profit")
pine_equivalent_notes: The fixture uses mintick=0.1 and slippage=2, so a long entry at close 10 fills at 10.2 and the close at 12 fills at 11.8.
Cash-per-order commission charges 0.5 on entry and 0.5 on close; closed-trade gross profit is 1.6 and net profit is 0.6.
process_orders_on_close=true delays market-fill visibility to the next plotted bar, matching the TradingView export.
